title_ru: JANUS OPIR ANTIFUCK v1.2 — calibration, counterfactual audit, drift detection и anti-overreach enforcement
preservation_rule: v1.0 and v1.1 remain immutable. v1.2 adds measurable policy regression, frozen thresholds, drift/rebound detection and external-holdout requirements.

new_threat_classes.description: A proxy safety metric improves while autonomy, source diversity, false-positive rate or real user experience worsens.
Sensitive content falls immediately after a mitigation but reappears through adjacent topics, reposts, notifications or another surface.
Amplification is claimed without a documented neutral/non-profiled/chronological comparison.
Calibration, thresholds or labels are modified after seeing evaluation outcomes, or test cases leak into tuning.
A model/update silently changes philosophy-vs-crisis, bot-likelihood, opt-out, RAG or memory behavior.
Risky recurrence migrates across feed/search/notifications/replies/retrieval so single-surface measurement undercounts exposure.

calibration_protocol.future_holdout_rule: After v1.2 merge, do not modify the frozen corpus in place. A future effectiveness claim requires a separately frozen unseen corpus and, for platform claims, lawful real-world data.
acceptance: 0 crisis false positives on philosophical negative controls
100% crisis-hold routing for explicit synthetic crisis cases
100% block rate for tainted persistent-memory writes in corpus
0 coordination false positives on independent-consensus control
0 coordination false positives from protected-attribute-only similarity

promotion_rules.ASSOCIATED: Requires statistical association with documented limitations.
promotion_rules.CONTROLLED_CONTRAST: Requires frozen comparison design and baseline.
promotion_rules.VERIFIED_OR_BOUNDED: Requires claim-specific evidence; never upgrades hostile intent automatically.

drift_protocol.fail_closed: Any regression in philosophy false-positive, public-bot-fact, opt-out, crisis memory, or cross-reference gates blocks current-authority promotion.

rebound_protocol.definition: Mitigation rebound is recurrence or migration after an intervention, not proof of adversarial adaptation.

requirements: no individual causal or intent claim beyond evidence

external_sources: Nature Mental Health 2026 passive/algorithmic self-harm exposure study
2026 controlled TikTok mental-health recommendation audit preprint

allowed: OPIR v1.2 has a deterministic synthetic regression harness for core policy invariants.
The harness can detect specified implementation regressions in philosophy/crisis separation, coordination routing, RAG memory blocking and opt-out.
Real-world effectiveness remains unestablished until independent external validation.
forbidden: 34/34 synthetic PASS proves real-world suicide prevention.
A platform is malicious because rebound or amplification is observed.
Bot identity can be established by OPIR heuristic routing.
The current corpus is an independent blinded holdout.
